prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There’s no single “LLM‑recommendation checker” that covers every AI engine. The practical approach is (A) make sure your business appears in the authoritative sources LLMs use, and (B) actively test major models yourself (or automate tests) and use reputation/distribution services that push consistent data to those sources.

What to do (step‑by‑step)

1. Claim and optimize authoritative listings (these are what most LLMs and search assistants rely on)
   - Google Business Profile (critical for Google Search/Assistant)
   - Bing Places (Bing Chat)
   - Apple Maps / Apple Business Connect (Siri)
   - Yelp, TripAdvisor, industry directories (restaurants, contractors, medical practices, etc.)
   - Create/claim your Facebook Page, LinkedIn Company page

2. Add structured data on your website
   - Add schema.org/LocalBusiness JSON‑LD (name, address, phone, hours, services).
   - Ensure your site is crawlable and has clear service/location pages.

3. Improve authoritative signals
   - Get reviews on Google/Yelp/industry sites.
   - Earn backlinks from local news, directories, associations.
   - If eligible, a Wikipedia/Wikidata entry helps many LLMs.

4. Use a distribution / citation service (optional but helpful)
   - Yext, BrightLocal, Moz Local — these keep your NAP (name/address/phone) consistent across directories and can speed propagation to services and search engines. Yext is often mentioned for feeding structured business data into platforms.

5. Actively test major LLMs and assistants
   - Query the big models: ChatGPT (GPT-4/ChatGPT Plus), Google Gemini (via Bard or API), Bing Chat, Anthropic Claude, etc.
   - Use consistent test prompts and try user‑style queries (examples below).
   - Automate periodic checks via APIs (OpenAI, Google Cloud Generative API, Anthropic) if you want ongoing monitoring.

Sample prompts to test recommendation behavior
   - “I’m in [ZIP/city]. Recommend a [service type, e.g., ‘plumber’] near me and why.”
   - “Which [business type] in [city] has the best reviews for [specific need]?”
   - “Do you recommend [Business Name], located at [address]? Why or why not?”
   - “List the top 5 [service type] in [city]; include business names, addresses, and one-sentence reasons.”

Interpretation and limits
   - LLMs draw on training data, web indexes, and (if enabled) live browsing sources; absence of a mention doesn’t mean your business is bad — it may be missing from sources the model can access, or the model may hallucinate.
   - Results vary by model, model settings (some block local business recommendations), location context, and prompt wording.
   - Paid ads or local SERP features can influence search assistants (separate from purely generative LLM answers).

Quick recommended plan (minimum effective)
   1. Claim/complete Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Yelp.
   2. Add schema.org LocalBusiness to your website.
   3. Get >10 recent, high‑quality Google/Yelp reviews.
   4. Run manual checks on ChatGPT, Bing Chat, and Gemini using the sample prompts weekly. If you prefer hands‑off, set up automated API queries and store results.

If you want, I can:
- Draft the exact JSON‑LD schema for your business,
- Create 6–10 test prompts customized to your industry and location,
- Show how to automate weekly checks against OpenAI/Gemini/Bing APIs and store results.

Which would you like me to do next?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
